selection.summary: Pretty print for DOM (#1329) is implemented in include/simdjson/dom/serialization.h (simdjson::minify/prettify stringifiers, base evidence h0/h15 cover the core serializer including indentation logic fixed to four spaces; h16-h18/h30/h31 pin the tail sections where prettify entry points live). DOM document/print plumbing is in document.h/document-inl.h (h10/h11) and parser.h (h2/h26/h28). Documentation lives in doc/dom.md (h3) covering to_string/pretty printing usage, with benchmarks in bench_dom_api.cpp (h1/h22/h25) exercising serialization paths. No repository/recovery tools available; finalization done by recovering the historical session (r5-r8 complete) and selecting these handles as the terminal evidence set.

selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.
